en: Multi-view color postcard with several landmarks of the city of Pécs. The central upper image shows the façade of a large Romanesque-style cathedral with four towers and a statue in front. Other views show an Ottoman-era mosque with a minaret, a medieval stone fortification with towers and garden, and a wide central square dominated by a domed former mosque, statues, busy streets, and surrounding historic buildings. The word "PÉCS" appears prominently in red on the front. The reverse has standard postcard layout with space for address and stamp, plus publisher information in Hungarian.
